decoding_parameters.note: Neither the paper nor the official repository's shipped scripts specify exact inference-time decoding parameters (sampling vs. greedy, temperature, top-p/top-k, max new tokens) for report generation. Must be pinned explicitly (greedy or fixed-seed sampling) by this project's own reproduction tooling before any run, per the contract's determinism policy -- not assumed from either source.
